# hostinger_vps_public_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH public key in the Hostinger account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) SSH public key content.
- `name` (String) Public key name.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Public key ID.
